description: We are StarCode, a team of Systems Engineering students at UNViMe.
summary:
Our project is an interactive educational website designed to help young children discover and learn about space exploration in a fun and engaging way.
To achieve it, we have developed different activities which aim to encourage children to use the information they have just learned.
details:
Our website offers an interactive learning experience where children can explore different topics related to space exploration. Each section presents information through short explanations and interesting facts, followed by optional activities that help children reinforce what they have learned.

The activities include short quizzes, memory matching games, sentence completion challenges and interactive rover challenges. These different formats encourage children to actively participate, remember key information, and learn through experimentation. A friendly robot companion is also included to guide children and make the experience more welcoming and enjoyable.

The main benefit of our project is making space science more accessible and entertaining for younger audiences. We hope to encourage children to explore scientific topics and help preserve knowledge about space exploration for future generations.

We developed the website using HTML, CSS and JavaScript, creating an interactive experience that can be accessed through a web browser. We also used Figma to design and organize the website's interface and ChatGPT and Claude as AI-assisted tools to help with coding and translation. We focused on making the content easy to understand, the activities engaging, and the overall experience suitable for young children.

We considered the learning experience and the age of our target audience when designing the activities and presenting the information.
